query: UPDATE mail_jobs j SET state = CASE WHEN j.state IN ('pending', 'in_progress') THEN 'cancelled' ELSE j.state END, terminal_at = CASE WHEN j.state IN ('pending', 'in_progress') THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE j.terminal_at END, nonce = NULL, payload = NULL WHERE j.user_id = ANY($1) AND j.payload IS NOT NULL AND ((j.state <> 'in_progress' AND j.expires_at <= clock_timestamp()) OR (j.authority_kind IN ('verification', 'recovery') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account_email_proofs p WHERE p.user_id = j.user_id AND p.token_hash = j.proof_digest AND p.expires_at > clock_timestamp())))
